reviews.t: This hair serum is the best I have ever bought
reviews.x: This hair serum is the best I have ever bought. I used to use all things Aveda and Paul Mitchel, but when I switched over to this serum I was super surprised. I live in Colorado and it is very dry weather. When I used less than a dime size amount I was surprised how fast my my hair repaired the split ends and the frizz. It is super light and my hair finally had a beautiful bounce to it. I feel like I just left the salon every day I use it. I don't cut my hair much because I am trying to grow it

A friend commented on how my hair was so soft and asked how I maintained it (it was a little coarse and dry before) so I know it was not just me, others noticed how effective this product is! It leaves a faint fragrance. I don't particularly like this scent but it's faint and goes away after a while, so it does not bother me. This summer I really messed with my hair, from color to product to harsh temperatures and my hair became dry and dull. I've been using on damp hair and just letting it in and go along my day. I love the scent and the way it makes my hair shinny and not oily.

This is a really great hair serum! It smells nice and makes my hair shiny without weighing it down or making it greasy. It does tame some frizz. But not all. Which is why I gave it 4 stars, and not 5. Would purchase again and recommend!

reviews.x: Excellent product. I have natural curly hair but blow-dry it.  I use it on my damp hair before I dry it and then to add shine to my hair when its dry.  I notice a difference when using it!

reviews.t: It smells really nice and does not leave my hair oily
reviews.x: So far this product has been helping out my hair though I been also been using other products to save my dry/damage hair.  It smells really nice and does not leave my hair oily.

reviews.x: This hair serum smells wonderful and works great!  After using the product for few times, I have noticed my hair is much shinier and healthier looking!  Highly recommended!
I apply this when my hair is about half dry and then finish drying it.  I love the smell.  It makes my hair nice and shiny and not greasy!

It is great for black hair!  I love it.  BRINGIT BACK AND ADVISE WHEN AVAILABLE
Use small amount, it lifts curls amd makes them soft.  Makes my hair happy!!

reviews.t: This serum compliments your hair color
reviews.x: My middle daughter has thicker hair, so I use this product on her. After she washes her hair she applies this serum. Her hair have 3 colors in them naturally, darker brown, lighter brown and red. When she applies this oil her classmates thought that she dyed her hair! It just bring so much shine and compliment her hair. After seeing that effect I applied it on my fine hair. I have highlights. It brings the different color in my hair as well. My co-workers thought that I just visited a hairdresse

I have fine thin hair which I wash and style too much! I need a product to help with the dryness and fly-away hair that doesn't get heavy or appear greasy.  I love this product.  I use just a very small amount of this serum on the palm of my hand, rub my hands together and then lightly touch my hair where it is needed. A small amount is all that is needed and I can do additional styling if needed.  I use it both on damp hair and dry hair. Either way it leaves my hair shiny, smoooth, and healthy

Opulent Hair Serum is infused with argan oil but it doesn't leave the hair greasy. This is a great product that helps tame unruly hair. It totally got rid of the frizziness of my hair after just one application. And I used  very little of it. I wanted to add that this product is made in the U.S. I am quite pleased with the results and will order it again. I received mine at a reduced cost in exchnage for my sincere review.

I have tried many products in my hair over the years. It is the frizzy type of curly and does not dry nicely. This is the best product I have used in a very long time. I do not have to set my hair immediately upon drying. My curls stay unfrizzed. My hair is soft and easy to work with. I would definitely recommend this product to any one trying to detangle curls, lessen the frizz, reduce damage to your hair.

reviews.t: This stuff smells amazing and keeps her hair super soft
reviews.x: I got this for my mother because she had extremely damaged + dry hair after getting a perm several times throughout her life. This stuff smells amazing and keeps her hair super soft!! She loves it! It helps calm frizzy and dry hair and makes it look moisturized and healthy.  I definitely recommend this product for anyone who's looking to strengthen and calm their dry hair

Super nutritious and thick luscious, not globby or sticky, perfect for curly hair that needs a bit of help not to frizz and straight hair as well, I love the ingredients of vitamin E and Argan oil. The fragrance is subtle and not over powering. I was able to take part in a special promotional discount and in exchange I wanted to provide my honest and unbiased opinion.

reviews.t: This is my favorite oil and this is my favorite company to buy ...
reviews.x: This is my favorite oil and this is my favorite company to buy it from. First the container itself is tall and sleek and gives me way more product then I would expect.  I have very thick dry hair and argan oil is the best to use on my split ends after shampooing and before exposing heat. I would definatley buy from this company again.

reviews.t: What a great product, I thought the price was a bit ...
reviews.x: What a great product, I thought the price was a bit high, but for the quality it is well worth it.  I can not even guess at the amount of money I have spent on hair care products only to have them let me down, but this product is different​ it does what it says it will do and better.  I love the way my hair feels now.

My natural hair has some silky smooth shine which I lost from past 5 years. I had used many color treatments and heated hair styling tools. My hair lost its shine and damaged. It's been a week I'm using this product. As of now, it feels like my hair got its natural shine back. Glad I tried this product.

I really like this serum, It leaves my hair nice and manageable which is saying something. The only thing is I can't stand the scent. It is so overwhelming that I think just for that reason I would never get it again. So if smells dont bother you then you should get this, if not then I really wouldnt.

I actually like the product.. it makes my hair shiny and looking and feeling hydrated... but something is wrong with the container it comes in. It was left laying on the side once and all of the serum leaked out (and it wasn't broken). Good product just make sure it just stays upright!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the serum makes their hair shiny and soft.
Many reviewers praise the pleasant scent, though a few note it is faint or wears off.
Reviewers commonly report the product does not leave hair oily or greasy.
Several reviewers say it helps tame frizz and hydrate dry or damaged hair, though one notes it does not tame all frizz.
A few reviewers mention it works well for curly or natural hair textures.
